Maya (eng-runtime): Quick profiler snapshot + dashboards question — embedding/rerank QPS steady at ~420r/s but 95p token-latency jumped ~18% after last-night kernel rollout. I think KV-prefetch path + small-batch fallback hit a slower kernel. Posting profiler dump and a proposed plan.

PerfBot: profiling summary (run id 1965432100):
```
kernel_active: int8_fused (80%) -> fallback generic_fp16 (20%)
kv_prefetch_hit_rate: 0.34
avg_batch_size: p50=6 p90=12 p95=20
endpoint: embed-rerank
vec_dim: 1536
qps: 420
per_token_p95_ms: 6.1 (+18%)
trace_sample: span(kernel=fallback,gpu_ms=4.9)
```

Kevin (eng-ml): Do we know whether the kernel switch was global for that model or per-instance? The quant-PR rolled an `int8_fused` kernel to gpushard-4 only; other shards fallback to generic_fp16. If rerank traffic is uneven across shards that would explain p95. Also note embeddings for cust-A are 1536 dims — higher memory working set -> fallback more often.

Samir (perf): Agree this smells like skewed distribution causing fallback. Suggests two quick dashboard additions: 1) token-level latency breakdown by kernel_choice label, 2) batch-size histogram for embed-rerank. Example PromQL to start with: `histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(redwood_token_latency_bucket{route="embed-rerank"}[5m])) by (le,kernel_choice))`

Julia (eng-platform): We need stable label names before we add panels. Do we already emit `kernel_choice`, `kv_prefetch` and `vec_dim` as labels on per-request metrics? If not, we'll need to add them to the tracing hook so dashboards are meaningful. Also please confirm cardinality impact.

Maya (eng-runtime): Currently we emit `kernel_hint` and `kv_prefetch_sample` on traces but not as metric labels — only as tag on spans. Plan: enable 5% kv-prefetch sampling with full metricization (kernel_choice, kv_prefetch, vec_dim, batch_size_bucket) to Grafana via Prometheus. Start canary now.

Kevin (eng-ml): Also watch batching heuristics: rerank inputs are short so p95 dominated by small batches. Consider raising adaptive_min_batch to 4 for embed-rerank and allow larger micro-batches on gpushard-4. That should reduce fallback pressure per-request (amortize kernel overhead).

Samir (perf): I'll add these KPIs to the perf dashboard: `redwood_per_token_latency_ms{route="embed-rerank"}`, `redwood_kv_cache_hit_ratio{route="embed-rerank"}`, `redwood_kernel_fallback_rate{kernel_choice!="int8_fused"}`, `redwood_embedding_batch_size_p50` and `redwood_avg_vector_dim`. Also propose a small panel that plots `fallback_rate` vs `p95` to catch regressions quickly.

Julia (eng-platform): I'll open a dashboard PR with panels and the PromQLs. Will tag @Kevin and @Maya for review. We should also include an alert: `expr: increase(redwood_kernel_fallback_count{route="embed-rerank"}[5m]) / increase(redwood_requests_total{route="embed-rerank"}[5m]) > 0.1` -> fire if fallback_rate > 10% and p95 > 5ms.

Maya (eng-runtime): Executing 5% kv-prefetch sampling now against a small canary (gpushard-4 only), enabling kernel_choice label emission. I'll post the first 1h sample in this thread tomorrow. If we see fallback hotspots we'll try adaptive_min_batch tweak and/or roll back the int8_fused rollout for that shard. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

Kevin (eng-ml): One more note — check quantization config: `enable_layerwise_fusion=true` caused a small memory inflation on 1536-dim models which may push some ops off the fast-kernel path. If sampling confirms, let's toggle that flag for canary.

Samir (perf): Great. Follow-up tasks:
- Add token-level kernel split panel (Samir)
- Dashboard PR (Julia)
- 5% sampling + traces (Maya)
- Review adaptive_min_batch tweak and quant flag (Kevin)

Maya (eng-runtime): Will report back with the sampled metrics and a short table of p50/p90/p95 by kernel_choice and batch_size buckets. Cheers.
